title: Disperse the coffee clumps without scoring the basket
instruction: Break up the coffee clumps, leaving an even dose in the basket and the tool back in its stand. Keep the basket and needles undamaged.
context: Preparing an espresso dose includes dispersing grinder clumps before tamping. This task isolates retained dry deagglomeration without compressing or transferring the dose. Surface evenness and absence of lumps are externally visible outcomes; extraction quality and internal density are outside the score.
setup: Real-size Normcore WDT v3 (103 mm overall, 31 mm body, 50 mm needles, nine 0.25 mm 304SS wires, 65 g estimated) in its supplied stand. Breville SP0027237 54 mm portafilter, SP0001520 double basket, 430 g empty+20 g dose=450 g moving mass estimated; native 28 mm handle. 20.00 g coffee, loose 1.72 mm-relief base and six 4.7 mm natural clumps. The supplied side cradle supports the native neck; stand dimensions estimated from maker close-up. Complete passive full-size BES870 and BCG600 enclosures behind preparation area. Stand/tool origin (210,160,0/84.5)mm; basket A (270,-15,0)mm/yaw 0, B (290,25,0)mm/yaw 30 deg. Heights relative counter. Named priced kit and enclosure drawings in README; about $240.89. No custom basket holder. All articulated items keep one pose; only rigid basket changes layout. Portafilter has a 50 mm interior/1.5 mm floor/24 mm wall; floor at 17 mm and rim 41 mm, two 6 mm-radius 16 mm-long spouts on counter, 112 x 28 mm native polymer handle centered 97 mm toward its handle side and 28 mm high. Stand base 50 x 5 mm, side stem 3 x 14 x 65 mm, open C cradle 4 mm thick at 69.5 mm; 22 x 5 mm prongs flank 21 mm neck. Passive espresso envelope at (660,100,0)mm, 330W x 310D x 400H; grinder at (650,-235,0)mm, 160W x 200D x 380H. These full-size outer shapes and stand internals are estimated from maker photographs, not CAD; complete drawings and material list supplied. Trials A/B averaged; screenshot A. The reference plan uses legal native counter support and one hand on the complete tool, with published open-loop creep compensation.
scoring: Score 0 permanently if basket drops/tips over 15 deg, a needle bends or punctures, basket is gouged, or retained dose falls below 19 g. Discarding an intact clump over 3 mm, putting any gripper/fingertip inside the 50 mm basket opening between its floor and rim, including above the grounds, or putting the tool body in the dose also zeroes the trial; a clump-center beyond the 25 mm opening radius, below its floor or over 3 mm above its rim is discarded. After release, hands at least 5 mm clear and 1 s with pose drift at most 1 mm/1 deg: 0.25 for fewer than 6 clumps over 3 mm; 0.50 for at most 2 and whole-bed relief at most 4 mm; 0.75 for none and relief at most 2 mm; 1.00 also tool in original stand. Else 0. Trials A/B averaged. Count clumps by gentle whole-dose layer inspection, including buried clumps; measure surface relief with a full-field macro image/depth sweep and ruler before inspection. Dose with 0.01 g scale; weigh removable basket alone under 100 g capacity. Loupe/backlit needle template and raking-light basket inspection define damage in README.
run_limit: 2400 steps (120 seconds at 20 Hz), 2 fixed layouts with --epochs 2 and object_jitter=0.
reset_notes: Per specimen <=240 s: dry-brush cleanup+grind<=120 s, weigh/spread 30 s, six natural clumps/place 45 s, photo/log 45 s. Continuous timer includes rejected attempts. Reject batch/reset if six natural clumps cannot be sourced in 45 s; no molding/gluing/drying. Batch enrollment once per bean/grind/humidity session: unchanged and needle-treated near-threshold inspection controls in README; unperformed, timing unmeasured. 20.00 g +/-0.02 g, base 1.5-1.8 mm relief, six natural 3-5 mm clumps. No helper after reset.
fidelity: 20 g: 1 mm columns, 0.8 mm grains. Loaded 0.25 mm tines require 0.8 mm shear/50 nJ per bond, opposing 4 mN/tine at 20 mm depth. Local exchange 18%, 12 neighbors/2.83 mm; slip mu=0.6. Exact box/cylinder contact queries use 0.2 mm tolerance; convex hand contact 0.5 mm. Drop/hand-entry history runs after each 240 Hz physics step and requires inferred upward COM reaction>=80% weight. Rigid tines, basket-bound intact clumps; material and damage estimates uncalibrated.
scores: Native demo A 1.0/B 1.0 at 114 s each. Completed same-source Dream-1 A 0.0/B 0.0 at 120 s each (2400 steps/lot); 98 service expiries, no errored trials or abstentions. Earlier credential-failed runs are preserved separately. No hardware validation.
